mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT m.id as message_id, m.content, m.created_at, s.id as session_id, s.session_key, 'content' as match_type FROM conversation_messages m INNER JOIN query_sessions s ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT -s.id as message_id, s.session_key as content, COALESCE(s.last_active_at, s.created_at) as created_at, s.id as session_id, s.session_key, 'title' as match_type FROM query_sessions s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.session_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_messages m2 WHERE m2.session_id = s.id AND m2.is_deleted = 0 AND m2.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) hits ORDER BY hits.created_at DESC, hits.message_id DESC, hits.session_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
